newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end up on retail speculation.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end up on retail speculation.

text.p: Thai stocks closed up on Tuesday after a wave of speculative buying of finance stocks by retail investors in light afternoon trade, analysts said.
The SET Index closed up 6.40 points, or 0.68 percent, to 953.68 on thin trade worth 2.617 billion baht. The SET-50 closed up 0.67 points to 72.88.
"I think this was speculation with retail investors looking for sectors on which to focus," said Susheel Narula, head of research at Seamico Securities.
"I think it'll be a dull week. I would think the foreigners will largely be staying clear," said Susheel.
He said market sentiment was weakening as it looked more likely that the New Aspiration Party (NAP) would emerge as the largest party following this Sunday's general election.
"You could take a bet on stocks that might do well under an NAP government but they are pretty high already," he said.
TelecomAsia again topped the active list and gained 1.5 baht to 57.5. Dhana Siam put on 3.0 baht to 78 and Ch Karnchang rose two to close at 144.
